sn46.35:1.1: ayoniso bhikkhave, manasikaroto anuppanno ceva kāmacchando uppajjati, uppanno ca kāmacchando bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya saṃvattati. anuppanno ceva vyāpādo uppajjati, uppanno ca vyāpādo bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya saṃvattati. anuppannañceva thinamiddhaṃ uppajjati, uppannañca thinamiddhaṃ bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya saṃvattati. anuppannañceva uddhaccakukkuccaṃ uppajjati, uppannañca uddhaccakukkuccaṃ bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya saṃvattati. anuppannā ceva vicikicchā uppajjati, uppannā ca vicikicchā bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya saṃvattatīti.
sn46.35:2.1: yoniso ca bhikkhave, manasikaroto anuppanno ceva satisambojjhaṅgo uppajjati; uppanno ca satisambojjhaṅgo bhāvanāpāripūriṃ gacchati -pe- anuppanno ceva upekhāsambojjhaṅgo uppajjati; uppanno ca upekhāsambojjhaṅgo bhāvanāpāripūriṃ gacchatīti.
